name: Swamp poplar
desc: Swamp poplar (Populus heterophylla): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 13 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Populus heterophylla, also known as downy poplar, swamp poplar and swamp cottonwood, is a large deciduous poplar belonging to the Populus genus of the family Salicaceae.
